character.name: Elian Vorath

spells.name: Chill Touch
spells.description: A skeletal hand wreathed in void energy reaches from the caster's outstretched fingers to touch a creature within 120ft, dealing 1d8 necrotic damage and preventing the target from regaining hit points until the start of the caster's next turn.

spells.name: Mage Hand
spells.description: A spectral, invisible hand appears within 30ft of the caster, allowing them to manipulate small objects, open unlocked doors, or stow items out of sight.

spells.name: Shield
spells.description: When the caster is hit by an attack or targeted by the magic missile spell, a shimmering barrier of void energy springs up, granting +5 AC and immunity to magic missile until the start of their next turn.

spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.description: Three glowing darts of solidified void energy streak toward a creature within 120ft, automatically hitting and dealing 1d4+1 force damage each for a total of 3d4+3 force damage.

traits: Speaks exclusively in quotes from ancient, forgotten texts, never using original phrasing
Writes in his sleep, often filling pages of the void tome with no memory of doing so
Loses one personal memory for every page he writes in the tome, with no way to recover them
Can decipher any written script, even those thought lost to millennia of decay
character.gear: Gnarled oak quarterstaff · Void-black leather-bound tome · 2 dried meat rations · Flint and steel · 50 ft hempen rope · Carved bone scribe's quill · Void-black inkwell · 5 tattered parchment scraps
character.story: Elian was a lowly scribe in the sunless library of Vaelthar, tasked with cataloguing forbidden tomes. One night, he found a book with blank pages that whispered his name. The first page he wrote erased the memory of his mother's face. Now he wanders blighted realms, filling the tome's pages before it consumes every trace of who he was. He speaks only in quotes from texts he's already forgotten, and writes in his sleep, his hand guided by something waiting in the void between the lines.

inventory.name: Gnarled Oak Quarterstaff
inventory.lore: Wrapped in frayed parchment scraps from the library's destroyed collections, the staff has absorbed more spilled void ink than blood over the years.
inventory.description: A sturdy gnarled oak staff, serviceable as both a walking stick and a weapon.

inventory.name: Void-Bound Blank Tome
inventory.lore: Found locked in the restricted section of the fallen library of Vaelthar, the tome's blank pages fill with glowing text each night, demanding memories to sustain its existence.
inventory.description: A thick leather-bound book with no title, its pages are blank save for faint pulsing void runes that appear when the holder loses a memory.
inventory.effects: Each page written by the user erases one of their own personal memories, filling the book's blank pages.

inventory.name: Carved Bone Scribe's Quill
inventory.lore: Carved from the femur of a scribe who attempted to burn the void tome three centuries prior, the quill moves on its own when the book is open, writing with eerie precision.
inventory.description: A sharp quill carved from bleached bone, perfect for writing on parchment or the pages of the void tome.

inventory.name: Silver-Light Healing Potion
inventory.lore: Brewed by the last apothecary of Vaelthar before the library fell, the potion glows with a faint silver light and tastes of old paper and rain.
inventory.description: A small glass vial of glowing silver liquid, warm to the touch.

inventory.name: Salted Blightwood Deer Rations
inventory.lore: Salted meat from deer hunted in the blighted woods surrounding the fallen library, the rations never spoil no matter how long they are carried.
inventory.description: Two strips of tough, salted dried meat, edible but tasteless.

inventory.name: 50 ft Hempen Rope
inventory.lore: Woven from fibers harvested from the overgrown courtyard of Vaelthar, the rope is strangely resistant to rot, cutting, and fraying.
inventory.description: A coil of sturdy hempen rope, 50 feet in length.

inventory.name: Worn Flint and Steel
inventory.lore: The striker and steel strip belonged to the head librarian who first discovered the void tome before vanishing without a trace, leaving only a half-burned candle behind.
inventory.description: A well-worn flint striker and matching steel strip, used to light fires.

inventory.name: Void-Black Inkwell
inventory.lore: Filled with ink that seems to absorb light, the inkwell never runs dry, and the ink it holds can only be used to write in the void tome.
inventory.description: A small glass inkwell filled with thick, light-absorbing black ink.

inventory.name: Void-black leather-bound tome
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
